rationale: C10 is the strongest plausible template because it is an earlier presidential letter to the incumbent chairman of the same International Development Advisory Board and uses the same Point Four, underdeveloped-areas, private-service, and free-world framing later adapted to recruit his successor. C13 supplies a close structural template for asking an individual to chair a presidential advisory board, while C05 supplies the Board's legal and administrative description. C10's convergence of exact institution, role, program, and policy language is sufficiently concrete and material to qualify.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As a private citizen you can perform an inestimable service to the free world by accepting the chairmanship of the International Development Advisory Board.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: At the time I requested you to serve as Chairman of the Advisory Board on International Development... realistic and continuing cooperation between private enterprise and government... vital... to the building of the security of the free world.
shared_material.explanation: Both letters recruit or describe the recruitment of a private citizen to chair the same Board and cast that service as important to the security of the free world.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In addressing the Congress this month on the Point 4 Program of technical cooperation in underdeveloped areas, I expressed my conviction that there is nothing of greater importance in all of our foreign policy.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Our policy in relation to the underdeveloped areas is one of the central points... desirable plans to accomplish... the broad objectives and policies of the Point Four program.
shared_material.explanation: The later letter reuses the same distinctive policy frame: Point Four work in underdeveloped areas as a central component of foreign policy.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Board was created in accordance with the mandate of the Act for International Development to advise and consult with me on the planning and operation of the Point 4 Program.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This is a special task which I am asking the Advisory Board to undertake for me in addition to the duties which are assigned to it under the Act for International Development.
shared_material.explanation: Both identify the same Board's statutory basis and presidential advisory function, reinforcing that the earlier letter provided institution-specific drafting material rather than merely a shared broad topic.
